test_title: PYST 50: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 01 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
A @ B means ‘A is the husband of B’.

A & B means ‘A is the mother of B’.

A # B means ‘A is the daughter of B’.

A % B means ‘A is the sibling of B’.

If R # P @ W % F & K, then how is R related to K?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png]

Statement given : R # P @ W % F & K

So,

 
• R # P → R is the daughter of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd02d366cb8692b3663a8e78e59140f05abf1213838ec1fae0562284f564c85e.png] 

 
• P @ W → P is the husband of W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d28660a811aea3bbd8fa8b55f24167ff9b38cfc0cc2583dc4d12e5fc8e5ab59.png] 

 
• W % F → W is the sibling of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ba1960ea4b7835f92107af2545c677355f100dd45af7381d9a62c43f85cac26.png] 

 
• F & K → F is the mother of K.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/522fa88df8a4b46fe1426ed6a062bdf0e7bacb4d89dd6e736ce284a73be9a328.png] 

Thus, according to the final family tree R is cousin i.e mother’s sister’s daughter of K.

Hence, "**Mother’s sister’s daughter**" is the correct answer.
